objective: Test whether a WAM's counterfactual video difference follows the visual consequence of its action difference.

inputs.observed: candidate-blind dense flow from left/right generated videos
inputs.expected: trajectory-conditioned flow from the two supplied action trajectories
inputs.common_mode: subtract right branch from left branch before scoring
inputs.invalid_policy: exclude and report unavailable; never zero-fill

metrics.direction_cosine: median pixel-vector cosine between observed and expected Delta F
metrics.response_gain: median(|observed Delta F| / |expected Delta F|) per twin
metrics.temporal_persistence: fraction of intervals retaining the dominant signed response
metrics.zero_control: observed Delta F magnitude with zero expected contrast

calibration.flow_backend: frozen RAFT-Large unless an independent A/B passes

claim_boundary: Structural ordinal/action-response consistency only; not metric distance, absolute speed, logged-GT fidelity, or proof of future-to-action causality.
promotion_status: candidate; Epona and DriveWAM cross-model controls completed, third-model and held-out calibration remain pending
